# Adv. Aroon Parsad, Advocate High Court, Karachi

Adv. Aroon Parsad is an Advocate of the High Court of Sindh, practising in Karachi, Pakistan since 13 August 2010. His chamber is at Room No. 409, Paradise Chamber, Near Passport Office, Saddar, Karachi. Phone and WhatsApp: +92 334 3707735. Email: email2aroon@gmail.com.

## Practice areas
Criminal law and bail (pre-arrest and post-arrest), civil litigation, family law and Guardian and Wards cases, constitutional petitions, cyber crime and defamation, student and education matters. He practises before the Sindh High Court and City Court, Karachi.

## Roles
- Founder and Chief Proprietor, Qanoon Ki Baat, a legal awareness platform publishing videos in Urdu on YouTube since 2012 (266 videos).
- Chairman and Team Leader, Young Lawyers Forum Pakistan.
- President, The Shelter (NGO).
- Former Treasurer, Karachi Bar Association (2017).
- Member, Education Committee, Sindh Bar Council.
- Mentor, Qanoonkibaat Internship Program for law students, City Court, Karachi.
